title: Tsutomu Nihei's Tower Dungeon Manga Tops 1 Million in Circulation Globally
content: The official X/Twitter account for manga creator Tsutomu Nihei 's editors announced on August 6 that Nihei's Tower Dungeon manga has over 1 million copies in circulation worldwide. Nihei launched the manga in Monthly Shonen Sirius in October 2023. Kodansha published the manga's sixth compiled book volume on March 9.
author: ANN

title: Phantom: Phantom of Inferno Game Slated for Steam on September 4
content: Game developer Nitroplus ' Nitro Origin label announced on August 7 its 2000 visual novel Phantom of Inferno will come to the Steam service under the title Phantom: Phantom Inferno on September 4. The game's contents will be the same as the 2013 PC port.
author: ANN

title: Seishun wa Sankakukei no Loop Manga to End in October
content: The September issue of Kadokawa 's Dragon Age magazine announced on Friday that Kei Hozumi and Mito's Seishun wa Sankakukei no Loop (Youth is a Triangular Loop) manga will end in the next chapter in the November issue in October.
author: ANN

title: Steins;Gate Re:Boot Game's Xbox Series X|S Release Delayed to October 29
content: Spike Chunsoft announced on Tuesday that it has delayed the Xbox Series X|S version of MAGES. ' Steins;Gate Re:Boot game from August 20 to October 29. Spike Chunsoft stated that it chose to delay the release to match the release date for the console version in the West.
author: ANN

title: 'Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun' Reveals Main Staff, Teaser Promo, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Naruki 's Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun ( Glasses with a Chance of Delinquent ) manga revealed the main staff, two teaser visuals (pictured above), and teaser promotional video on Tuesday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: My Hero Academia Creator’s New Manga Deserves To Be a Longer Series
content: Two years after My Hero Academia reached its conclusion, Kohei Horikoshi returned with a new one-shot manga in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine. The one-shot was released on August 10th, 2026, and caused quite a buzz thanks to the creator’s highly anticipated return.
author: ComicBook

title: Firefly Wedding Anime Reveals Second Teaser Trailer and Additional Cast, October 9 Premiere
content: Firefly Wedding TV anime revealed its second teaser trailer, revealing two additional cast members ahead of its October 9, 2026 premiere. The first promotional video was revealed in March. Kento Ito will voice Kotaro Ogawa, while Kenjiro Tsuda joined the cast as Mitsueda.
author: Anime Corner

title: Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent Anime's Teaser Reveals Staff, 2027 TV Debut
content: The official website for the anime of Naruki 's Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent ( Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun ) manga unveiled a new teaser promotional video and visuals for the anime on Tuesday. The teaser announces the main staff and the 2027 television premiere for the anime.
